[SWS_PER_00529]
⌈
ara::per::ReadWriteAccessor::WriteText
shall write the characters provided as ara::core::StringView to the file,
overwriting current content and advancing the end of the file if necessary.
The
position shall be set to character following the last character that was written during
this operation, or to the end of the file.
⌋

[SWS_PER_00529]
⌈
ara::per::ReadWriteAccessor::WriteText shall write
the characters provided as ara::core::StringView to the file at the current
position, possibly overwriting current content and advancing the end of the file if
necessary. The position shall be set to the character following the last character that
was written during this operation, or to the end of the file.
⌋
